notes: Trusted screenshot over raw. Canvas is pure #000 (raw reports no explicit bg color because the body black comes from a parent/WebGL layer not sampled as backgroundColor; every sampled bg is a translucent white overlay). Single accent = white itself; there is no chromatic accent — color comes entirely from the project thumbnails. The dominant backgroundColor rgba(255,255,255,0.15) (260 hits) is the frosted-glass fill on the floating nav capsule and the metadata chips, paired with a rgba(255,255,255,0.2) hairline and 14px radius — normalized as surface/glass-fill + hairline roles. Two type families only: Helvetica Now (body/UI, w500) and ballinger-mono (the tiny ~10.9px labels, w400) — mono size normalized to 0.6875rem. Big pill radii 40/48px kept distinct from the 14px chip radius; full radius inferred for circular controls. Display sizes (48/56px) are sparse (hero line + the consent card's Accept/Decline), not a deep heading scale. Motion is overwhelmingly 0.2s ease-in-out; the lone springy cubic-bezier(0.93,-0.24,0.4,1.17) overshoot is the playful capsule/label reveal — kept as the signature easing. No box-shadows anywhere; depth is faked with translucency + blur, so shadow normalized to none. MOTION: the spectacle is canvas-driven and NOT DOM-distillable — across frames s00→s10 the grid does not scroll-translate (9 position:fixed pins; the only DOM property animation captured is the timezone icon opacity 0.85→0.40). Real motion lives in 1 <canvas> + ~330 rAF calls + 13 mousemove listeners (cursor-reactive field) plus 22 @keyframes whose NAMES carry the intent: styles_image-reveal (in-view plate clip, 350ms stagger, eased cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)), styles_rotation (ambient spin loop), Loader_skew/stretch/move-* + TransitionElementContainer (skew-stretch page transition, 700–1400ms), cubic-bezier(0.93,-0.24,0.4,1.17) overshoot on the capsule reveal, Timezones_blinking-dot. Durations/easings/stagger repointed to .motion.params. reduced_motion = not-respected (prmRules:0) — a real defect on a heavy-motion site; any reuse must add prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks. scroll_effects.property uses canvas/clip as coarse buckets since the exact animated props are inside the shader, not the DOM. Genuinely-new techniques (cursor-reactive-canvas-field, overshoot-capsule-reveal, skew-stretch-page-transition) have no existing recipe and are listed as patterns_to_build in the exemplar, not in patterns:.
